name: Champion

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47536_CHAMPION_BREW._PLC.-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding

unitNormalised.basis: market-cap anchored: cap 8.948e+10, net profit 1.78988e+09, revenue 2.97976e+10; at x1 P/E 49.99, P/S 3.003

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed.
